summary: Executed backend + frontend regression on the current external preview URL. Verified direct brochure download (no gate/popup), homepage reveal visibility under slow/fast scroll, cross-route navigation, contact submit, and PDF delivery endpoints.

integration_issues.issue: Direct navigation to /services#modular-kitchens loads route but does not scroll target section into viewport on initial load.

action_items: Fix hash-anchor scrolling on initial /services#<slug> load (ensure deep-link section is brought into view after SPA route render).
critical_code_review_comments: Deep-link reliability gap: browser hash is present but section is not auto-scrolled into viewport on initial route load, which can weaken brochure/service cross-link UX and SEO deep-link behavior.
Brochure download architecture is robust: static bundled file + native <a download> keeps downloads functional even if /api/** requests fail.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ enquiry records via backend pytest and one TEST_ contact submission via UI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Download regression passed on desktop+mobile: all three brochure buttons produce Suvi-Interior-Brochure.pdf, stay on same page, open no popup/dialog, and generate zero POST /api/enquiries during download-only run. Bundled /brochures PDF validated (magic bytes, size 2-6MB range, 7 pages with text/images). /api/brochure.pdf still returns attachment filename. Homepage headings/images remained visible after quick and slow scroll in normal + reduced-motion checks. Only open issue observed: /services#modular-kitchens not auto-scrolling to target section on initial direct load.
rca_of_the_issue: Repro: open /services#modular-kitchens directly. Location hash resolves but target section top remains below viewport (observed top ~921px on 1920x800), indicating missing/late hash-scroll handling after SPA render. Likely mitigation: on Services route mount (or generic route effect), if location.hash exists, query target id and call scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) after content/layout paint.
